name: BanditRL.OnlineConvex.affine_support_of_domain_interior
statement: theorem affine_support_of_domain_interior (f : E → EReal) (hbot : ∀ y, f y ≠ ⊥) (hf : IsConvexExtended f) (x : E) (hx : x ∈ interior (effectiveDomain f)) : ∃ (a : E →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℝ), ((a x + b : ℝ) : EReal) = f x ∧ ∀ y, ((a y + b : ℝ) : EReal) ≤ f y
